title: A management game where you own a store with keyboards
author: W0RKABLE
selftext:
I'm making a game where you manage a store with keyboards. Regular keyboards, gaming keyboards or high-end enhusiast mechanical keyboars.

I would really like feedback on the art-style and the overall theme of the game.

How does it look?

comments.author: BlindMeridianStudios
comments.body: I love it, personally. So niche & cool. That's where passion lies.

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body: Thank you so much! Is this something you would play?

replies.author: BlindMeridianStudios
replies.body:
I don't play many games any more.

It'd have to do something really strikingly different than a normal Tycoon / Management game.

I am also not your potential customer profile.

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: The store atwork looks fine. I'm not show if the "people" fit the store artwork

comments.author: homiej420
comments.body: Cute, i like the art style

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body:
since appearently walls can be any shape and angle, you need to do this in 3d. dont think about 2d art with this freedom in wall placement.

and then you also solve your people problem i guess, with low poly.cuz animating all those random people will take a lot of YOUR time (ai cant do it) and probably wont fit in

it doesnt look bad, but i see a ton of problems.

also : only keyboards? nbothing else , no mouses, no monitors, only keyboards? sounds like your game-loop needs to be on point to not get boring fast
